timing_caveat: Large timing changes/outliers are retained. Within a fixture/backend all six state hashes, stopping counts/reasons and accuracies agree. Seed order and elapsed machine time are confounded; CPU load, temperature, power and affinity were not instrumented in this frozen protocol, so timing causes cannot be established.
